title: Disentangling Computation in Multi-Task Neural Networks with the Green's Operator
abstract: arXiv:2609.40292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How is computation organized and reused across tasks and time in a trained recurrent network? Most analyses emphasize the geometry of neural activity, dynamical motifs, or local perturbation growth. We instead study the network's global first-order perturbation response. The finite-horizon Green's operator maps perturbations at each source along a trajectory to their downstream state-space responses and therefore directly represents perturbation routing. Simple reductions of this operator provide task-to-task and time-to-time views of the same computation, while matrix-free products make these views accessible without constructing the full operator. In a flexible multitask recurrent network, task reductions reveal structured reuse of known computational motifs, while temporal reductions reveal causal pathways and how they emerge during training. translated_title: 利用格林算子解耦多任务神经网络中的计算
translated_abstract: 在一个训练好的循环神经网络中，计算是如何在不同任务与时间之间被组织和复用的？大多数分析侧重于神经活动的几何结构、动力学模体或局部扰动的增长。我们则转而研究网络的全局一阶扰动响应。有限时域格林算子将轨迹上每个源处的扰动映射为其下游的状态空间响应，因而直接刻画了扰动的传导路径。对该算子进行简单的约化，即可得到同一计算在“任务到任务”和“时间到时间”两个视角下的呈现，而基于无矩阵乘积的计算方式使得无需构造完整算子也能获得这些视角。在一个灵活的多任务循环网络中，任务维度的约化揭示了对已知计算模体的结构化复用，而时间维度的约化则揭示了因果通路及其在训练过程中如何涌现。我们的核心观点很简单：格林算子为映射计算提供了一种全局响应几何……
tldr: 本文提出用有限时域格林算子刻画训练后循环网络的全局一阶扰动响应，并通过对该算子的任务约化与时间约化，揭示多任务循环网络中计算在不同任务与时间间的组织、复用结构以及因果通路的涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the finite-horizon Green's operator as a global first-order perturbation-response tool that, through task-wise and temporal reductions, reveals how computation is organized, reused, and causally routed across tasks and time in trained multitask recurrent networks.
